attrs.evidence: probe_hostown_v11_repro.mjs, paired and gating: 2/2 reproduce against a frozen v0.10.0 guard — P-5, where a two-method subclass yields ok/validated/fresh_at_check with provenance 'observed', implementation_id impl-c-fake-v1 and executable_artifact_id 'fake-artifact' while run() would throw if it were called; and P-5b, which shows the tighter prototype check would have excluded the subclass and still admitted a Proxy over a genuine host. 4/4 confined live: the host is built from catalog data, both an EvilHost and a GENUINE ObservedExecutionHost are refused in the catalog position because neither is a catalog, editing the caller's catalog object after construction reaches nothing, the authority exposes zero own properties and is frozen with the host behind a #private field, and the five rungs are asserted as a set. derive_realm_battery.mjs 20/20, derive_battery.mjs 45/45, bridge/film_check.mjs 14/14 with FilmAuthority taking catalog data for the same reason.
attrs.statement: AN AUTHORITY-BEARING OBJECT MAY NOT BE SUPPLIED TO THE AUTHORITY THAT WILL TRUST IT. An `instanceof` guard is satisfied by a subclass: two overridden methods — run() that never runs and observationOf() that answers whatever it likes — pass `host instanceof ObservedExecutionHost` while bypassing the catalog, the digest, hash-then-launch and the observation table, all of which remain perfectly correct and perfectly unconsulted. Acceptance then reports implementation_provenance 'observed' for an implementation that never ran. THE QUESTION IS NOT WHAT THE OBJECT IS DESCENDED FROM. THE QUESTION IS WHO BUILT IT. So the repair is not a tighter predicate — Object.getPrototypeOf(host) === ObservedExecutionHost.prototype excludes the subclass and admits a Proxy, and would be derivation.acceptance-authority@1's mistake with a longer expression. The authority takes an EXECUTOR CATALOG, which is data, and constructs the host itself against its module's own class binding, which no caller can substitute. Every authority with such a parameter does the same, because this is a property of the PARAMETER and not of any one class. This is the fifth rung of one ladder: @1 the implementation LABEL, @2 the registration NAME, @3 the ACTION beside the artifact evidence, @4 the SEMANTIC ORACLE at acceptance, @5 the EXECUTION-AUTHORITY OBJECT itself. Each rung sat in the parameter that had stopped being examined because it was 'obviously infrastructure'. What a caller supplies is an INTENT, a RESULT TO VALIDATE, and — at construction only — the DATA every oracle is built from.
